observations: Black DSLR camera body with 'NIKON' branding on the top left and 'D90' on the front right.
Tamron lens attached, with 'TAMRON' and 'AF' visible on the front barrel.
Lens has a gold-colored ring with 'AF' and 'TANABON' branding.
The camera has a top-mounted LCD screen and a rear LCD screen.
A black neck strap is attached to the camera body.
The shutter count is not visible in any of the provided photos.

claims.evidence: The photos show the camera in a clean state, but 'faily' is a subjective term for used condition.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The camera may not power on or the LCD screen may be dead.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on and the screen displaying a menu.

risks.risk: The shutter count may be high, indicating significant use.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from a recent photo or a third-party shutter count tool.
risks.if_unproven: as having a high shutter count

risks.risk: The lens may have fungus, scratches, or internal damage.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the front and rear lens elements.

risks.risk: The battery may be dead or the charger may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera taking a photo while the battery is being charged.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
A clear photo of the shutter count label on the camera body.
A photo of the lens glass with the lens cap removed.
A video of the camera powering on and the screen working.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
